about: Raw record of the first Phase 0 / 0B measurements on Studio-dev (chain 61997). Written by hand from observed output of scripts/spike.mjs and ad hoc probes; every hash below was returned by the network. Nothing in this file is a conclusion about the thesis. The discovery gate is NOT passed.
account: throwaway test account funded with sim_fundAccount; key kept in the gitignored .env.local

bradbury.fundedBy: sim_fundAccount not available, external faucet needed

asimov.note: same chain id as Bradbury, same host family

observations.what: genlayer-js 2.0.0-rc.1 getTransactionLifecycle({hash}) is rejected by Studio-dev with 'txId is required'. The raw RPC with {txId} works.
observations.evidence: gen_getTransactionLifecycle returned storedStatus, projectedStatus, resolutionAction, decisionId, decisionActive, evaluatedAt for tx 0xbb4a3f494a2da0ba7703ef97227742c44618eeee125c3238177b8566eef0e79f

observations.what: Observed lifecycle of a decision transaction: Proposing, Accepted about 8 s after submit, Finalized about 43 s after submit (single sample, appealDeadline 30 s after materialization).
A transaction whose execution ended FINISHED_WITH_ERROR still reached Finalized. Status alone does not prove success (v1 defect C6).
Two message allocations with the same recipient and the wildcard callKey are rejected at submission with AllocationDuplicateKey.

Bisect of a judge contract. No emits: execution FINISHED_WITH_RETURN. Both emits: FINISHED_WITH_ERROR. Only emit(on='accepted'), with onAcceptance false or true in the fee allocation: FINISHED_WITH_ERROR. Only emit(on='finalized'): FINISHED_WITH_RETURN, message recorded on the tx.

UNEXPLAINED. The finalized-only judge executed fine, showed resolutionAction Finalize at about 20 s, and then ended with status CANCELED at about 45 s with no triggered child transaction. Reproduced twice. Cause not yet isolated (candidates: sink.record failing as a child, fee allocation not covering the child, Studio-dev behaviour).
Studio-dev rate limit: 500 requests per hour per account bucket 'standard'. Reached during sampling at 4 s intervals; retry_after 2060 s. Every later experiment must sample sparsely.

gate: NOT PASSED. No finalized-stage message has yet been observed arriving at a sink, so E1 and E5 have no result, and E2, E3, E4, E6 have not been run.
